important_instructions: Only online applications will be accepted. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Qualifications must be obtained from approved recognized institutions. Documents in support of qualifications, experience, and age must be produced in original when called for document verification and interview. Strong academic background with proven excellence in written and verbal English communication. Consultant (Graphic Designer): Minimum 5-8 years of proven experience in strategic understanding of brand design and creative direction, experience in leading design projects or managing a creative team, and a strong portfolio highlighting versatility, conceptual thinking, and design leadership. Consultant (Video Editor): Minimum 5-8 years of proven experience as a Video Editor in a professional setup – preferably in TV media, advertising, digital media, broadcasting, or a creative agency environment. Experience working on social media videos, brand films, promotional videos, event coverage, interviews, documentaries, and corporate communications content.

faq.question: Q1. What is AAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AAI Recruitment 2026 is an engagement notification issued by EdCIL (India) Limited on behalf of Airports Authority of India (AAI) for 3 Consultant posts in the Corporate Communications Directorate at Western Region, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are available: 1 for Consultant (Content Writer), 1 for Consultant (Graphic Designer), and 1 for Consultant (Video Editor).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 25.10.2026 up to 05:30 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the monthly remuneration for AAI Consultants?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive an all-inclusive monthly remuneration of Rs. 1,20,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for AAI Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years as of 25.10.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required for Consultant (Content Writer)?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor’s degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, or English Literature, OR a Bachelor’s Degree in any stream with a Master’s Degree in Mass Communication / Journalism from a recognised university.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee for AAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AAI Consultants?
faq.answer: The selection process is based on academic qualifications and experience, followed by document verification and an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, but candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of engagement for AAI Consultants?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely on a contractual basis for an initial period of one year, with provisions for extension as per requirement and rules.
